title: The Night Cream for the Leather Boots
youtube_title: The Night Cream for the Leather Boots | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Leaving a cover on is a kind of trust.
summary: At a quiet craft corner with paper, paste, and a wooden rack, Pilar wants to check on a leather boots wearing a thin coat of cream before it is ready. With Auntie Luz nearby, Pilar leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
